title: Replace upgrade_to_cloud_cancel_collision_test.dart's synthetic phase simulator with a test that drives the real _CollisionBlock
rule: TQ-8 (regression test must fail without the fix, red-first)

evidence.quote:
// Because we cannot instantiate private sealed classes from outside the
// library, we test via a custom widget that exposes the phase transition
'FIXED behavior (AN-5): cancel returns to form phase (form-visible appears)',

why: Both the 'BUGGY' and 'FIXED' tests pump a hand-written `_CollisionCancelSimulator` whose behaviour is selected entirely by a `buggyBehavior` flag the test itself sets — neither test imports, renders, or interacts with `upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart`'s real `_CollisionBlock`/`_UpgradeToCloudScreenState`. Reverting the actual AN-5 fix at upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart:544-546 (e.g. changing `_PhaseForm()` back to `_PhaseCollision()`) would not fail this suite — it tests a parallel reimplementation, not the fixed code, so it provides zero regression protection despite its name and file header claiming otherwise. The sibling file upgrade_to_cloud_screen_l1_test.dart honestly `skip: true`s the same scenario with a documented Isolate limitation instead of faking a pass.
recommendation: Add a `@visibleForTesting` seam (e.g. an injectable PasswordHasher/verification hook that resolves without Isolate.spawn) so the real _CollisionBlock can be reached and its onCancel exercised directly in a widget test; until that seam exists, rename this file/tests to make clear they validate a simulated model only, and don't count them as AN-5 regression coverage in the suite inventory.
acceptance_criteria: A test exists that pumps the real UpgradeToCloudScreen (or _CollisionBlock via an exposed seam), and reverting upgrade_to_cloud_screen.dart:544-546 to the pre-AN-5 behavior makes that test fail.

corrections: Quote for line 544 splices lines 544+546, silently skipping line 545 (`_cloudPasswordController.clear();`) with no ellipsis — minor, doesn't change substance.
